Name: JP's Utility Machines - Omega Potions
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center]﻿﻿[color=#00ff00][u]Omega Potions[/u][/color][/center][/size][i]
[color=#00ffff][size=5]This mod provides you with 11 different potions, each focused on one of the game's skills. Each potion has 4 levels that you will unlock as you progress in each of your skills. Each has unique requirements to be crafted and the effects they provide are hopefully well balanced.[/size][/color][/i]


[list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]Level 1 Potions:[/i][/b][/size][/color] [size=4]You get them from day 1, all 11 potions will be available. You can create them from the Crafting Menu. The materials needed are not very varied and are not difficult to obtain. Naturally they are the weakest potions but they last the longest. . [i][color=#00ff00]The duration of some of these potions lasts until you go to sleep.[/color] [/i][/size]
[/list][size=4][i]
[/i][/size][list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]Level 2 and 3 Potions:[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=4] [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]When you reach Farming level 4, you will unlock the Magic Chalice. If you place a level 1 potion it will upgrade to level 2, and then to level 3. Upgrading takes time but the benefits are worth it. [/size][/color]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]
[/size][/color][list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]Omega Potions:[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4] [/color][size=4]When you reach level 6 of the different skills, you will unlock the Omega level of the different potions, the most powerful of all. These are prepared in the kitchen and require the most powerful and scarce materials in the valley. Their power is immeasurable. [/size][color=#f4f4f4][/color]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][b][size=2]
[/size]
[/b][/color][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]Little Trick: You can't use several potions at the same time, except for the Speed potion and any other potion![/b][/size][/color]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
